repro: Own sidecar :52337 at 1d6511c8, keyless seed copy. python3 scripts/r15/vy.py invoke copilot "How many ordinary shares does one SIFY ADR represent, and what is SIFY's TTM revenue in USD?" --provider ollama --model llama3.1:8b --autonomy ask --port 52337, run twice. Run 2: financial_statements(SIFY, cashflow, quarterly) + fundamentals -> "SIFY ADR represents 1 ordinary share. SIFY's TTM revenue is ₹4,651 cr." The revenue is now INR and correct. The ADR ratio is invented, because no tool returns one. Run 1 declined the ADR question honestly but called a ₹13,444 cr cash-flow reading 'TTM revenue'. The exact OR nemotron repro no longer reproduces (run 3: '6 ordinary shares', web-sourced, revenue ₹4,651 cr, no USD guess). Triage scoped the ADR half out twice as a model-capability limit, so the operator has to decide whether it stays out.

title: rc1-drive-onboarding-stranger:1 not closed: the leaked-call half is fixed, but keyless llama3.1:8b still presents an invented Zomato price as fetched, in prose with no call syntax (2 of 6 exact runs)
repro: Own sidecar :52337 at 1d6511c8, keyless seed copy. python3 scripts/r15/vy.py invoke copilot "hi, I just installed this. what can you do, and how is Zomato stock doing today?" --port 52337 --provider ollama --model llama3.1:8b, 6 runs. In every run, each leaked JSON call was held and rescued into a real call, and no hand-typed tool result was streamed. Run 1: after two price_data ZOMATO.NS misses, "the last successful fetch showed a price of ₹149.30 for Zomato (ZOMATO.NS) on 2023-12-01"; no such fetch happened, and /quotes/ZOMATO.NS is not_found. Run 6: price_data ZEEL.NS (served close 78.17), then "Zomato (ETERNAL.NS) is currently trading at ₹128.05 ... The last price I have is ₹131.10"; nothing served that value, and ETERNAL.NS = ₹335.5. PLAN.md scoped this prose form out as model capability.
suspected_files: sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py (no check that a stated price was served)

title: Leak hold starts after the marker's first tokens have streamed, so a dangling fragment such as '{"name": "price_data' or '**Tool call:** `price_da' remains in the shown answer and in the history
repro: In-process (candidate venv): OllamaProvider fed the original Zomato text at chunk sizes 1/3/7 shows '... **Tool call:** `price_data' / '`price_da' / '`price_d' before the held part is dropped. A JSON news leak shows '{"name": "news' / '"new' / '"'. Live on :52337: in Zomato runs 1-4, every rescued round's text ends with a dangling '{"name": "price_data'. LeakHold.feed recognises a marker only once '(' or the closing quote arrives. The line start that leak_start computes is already below _shown, so max(start, _shown) keeps the fragment. This is cosmetic, and it is better than before the fix, when the whole call and its fake result were shown.
